correctness.rationale: Orthogonal mean/contrast decomposition yields the given proximal map. On the active region its Jacobian modulo constants is aI+(1-a)uu^T, while inside the ball it is zero. Since the first-difference map onto R^(n-1) is surjective, the rank-one BV operator norm is V(u) max_j|<u,b_j>|. Dualizing edge signs and using the exact two-vector spectral radius formula gives (||D^T eps||||b_j||+|eps_j|)/2. Alternating edge signs maximize 4n-6, middle step maximizes floor(n^2/4)/n. The derivative at the shrinkage boundary gives the sharp limiting lower bound and the strict inequality on nondegenerate line segments gives nonattainment. Enumerated all sign chambers independently for n=2..9; the all-n bound is analytical.
